text:
Tage Thompson has 14 goals in 22 games, nine of them in his last ten, and he is fourth in the league in wins added by goals. Buffalo leans on him for nearly 20 minutes a night, and his top shot speed of 100 mph ranks at the very top of the league in NHL EDGE tracking.

The chances are real. He has 10.64 expected goals (the quality of his chances), and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him among the league's best last season at getting to the home-plate area in front of the net, often off passes across the slot. That is a sustainable way to score.

The finishing is where we'd hold back. He is shooting about 16%, a touch above his 15% last season, and 3.36 goals ahead of his chances. His team has also scored 6.4 more goals than expected with him on the ice, while Buffalo's five-on-five share with him is close to even. He scored 40 goals last season, so the talent is not in question; the current rate is just running a little hot. Watch the shot volume: 89 in 22 games is the part that comes from him, not the bounces.
